rumours: Travellers in Silvenar whisper that old toll-charters across Malabal Tor are being bought up by secretive factors.
Watchmen along the Malabal Tor trails say lanterns have been seen moving inside the ancient vaults after midnight.
Stewards serving The Silvenar & Green Lady posted fresh commissions at Silvenar for anyone who can secure the outlying ruins of Malabal Tor.
Wayfarers resting in Malabal Tor swear the roadside shrines hum softly whenever a storm rolls across the border.
Clerks in Silvenar complain that sealed crates bypass the customs posts of the Court of the Silvenar without inspection.
Local folk in Malabal Tor still leave an offering on the boundary stones to keep the older spirits quiet.
A chronicler arrived in Silvenar last week asking after First and Second Era garrison rolls for Malabal Tor.
Apothecaries in Silvenar pay good silver for rare moss and resin gathered from the ruins of Malabal Tor.
Veterans in Silvenar still debate which company held the frontier pass of Malabal Tor during the Crisis.
Smugglers working the back-tracks of Malabal Tor use chipped milestones to mark their midnight drop-sites.
legends: In the First Era, when the earliest boundary stones were raised across Malabal Tor, the watchtowers of the Court of the Silvenar echoed with bronze horns for seven nights.
Old ballads of Silvenar tell of a standard-bearer who sealed his company's charter chest beneath a stronghold in Malabal Tor and swore never to yield the key.
Folk in Malabal Tor speak of the Twilight Surveyor, a phantom chronicler who walks the milestones toward Silvenar during Frostfall, measuring whether the old pacts still hold.
Beneath the oldest foundations of Silvenar, builders claim an unbroken subterranean conduit still links the shrines of Malabal Tor.
During the Second Era interregnum, an envoy of the Court of the Silvenar walked alone into the deepest ruin of Malabal Tor and returned with the truce-ring that still hangs in Silvenar.
Every century when the moons align over Malabal Tor, the sunken bells near Silvenar are said to chime three times beneath the earth.
Carvers in Silvenar preserve the tale of the First Warden of Malabal Tor, who traded his shadow to seal the lower fault-gates against intruders.
According to the temple rolls of Silvenar, the oldest road through Malabal Tor follows the footprints of the ancestors who first named the land.

songs.title: The High Road to Silvenar
lines: O the road to Silvenar winds ancient and long,
Where the wardens of Malabal Tor still march with a song;
Keep your lantern trimmed bright through the mist and the rain,
Till the gates of Silvenar rise before us again.

songs.title: Watchfires of Malabal Tor
lines: Raise a cup for Malabal Tor, where the old beacons gleam,
Above ruin and valley, by causeway and stream;
Though the borderlands shift and the smugglers may scheme,
Still the folk of Silvenar keep the ancestors' dream.

songs.title: Boundary Stones of Silvenar
lines: From the pass to the harbour the mile-pillars stand,
Cut by chisels of old across Malabal Tor's proud land;
Count the leagues into Silvenar with steel in your hand,
For the spirits of Malabal Tor bow to no stranger's command.

songs.title: Lamplight in Silvenar
lines: When the dusk settles deep over Malabal Tor's wide shore,
And the barges tie fast by the customhouse door;
May the wards of Silvenar hold the night-wind at bay,
Till the horns of the morningwatch welcome the day.

abamath.hook: Abamath (dungeon fixed) stands at (-5000, 10500) in Malabal Tor, where the weathered masonry still bears the marks of Silvenar's frontier history.
abamath.rumour: Folks in Silvenar say anyone who searches Abamath in Malabal Tor will find traces of the old wardens and recent smugglers' caches.
abamath.quest: Investigate the reports surrounding Abamath in Malabal Tor and report to the wardens at Silvenar.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Abamath
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through Malabal Tor, we set our transit-rod at Abamath (survey grid -5000, 10500 under the Court of the Silvenar). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Silvenar refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

notes.title: Warden's Dispatch: Abamath
notes.author: Chancery of Silvenar
pages: To the watch-corporal posted at Abamath (-5000, 10500): by warrant of The Silvenar & Green Lady in Silvenar, patrols along this sector of Malabal Tor are to inspect all night-convoys bearing unsealed casks and report any broken boundary stones to the Court of the Silvenar.

notes.title: Factor's Private Missive from Abamath
notes.author: Factor-Clerk Vorian
pages: My dear colleague in Silvenar: the inventory cached at Abamath (grid -5000, 10500 in Malabal Tor) remains untouched by the bailiffs of the Court of the Silvenar. So long as the border watches stay occupied, our drovers can move two dozen crates a week past Abamath without paying toll.

notes.title: Antiquarian Notes on Abamath
notes.author: Chronicler Mirabelle of the Archives
pages: Among the secondary sites of Malabal Tor, Abamath (situated at coordinates -5000, 10500 within the jurisdiction of the Court of the Silvenar) merits closer study. The stonework preserves tool-marks characteristic of early regional craft oriented toward Silvenar.

notes.title: Wayfarer's Warning at Abamath
notes.author: Road-Warden of Silvenar
pages: Travellers bound for Silvenar across Malabal Tor: do not unhitch your teams at Abamath (-5000, 10500) after the evening mist rises. Outriders of the Court of the Silvenar reported hostile movement inside the perimeter of Abamath last fortnight.

notes.title: Rubbing from the Boundary Stone at Abamath
notes.author: Wayshrine Chronicler
pages: Transcribed from the weathered lintel at Abamath (-5000, 10500 in Malabal Tor): 'Here stands the watch-stone of the Court of the Silvenar, raised to guard the approach to Silvenar. Let whoever takes shelter within these walls keep the lamp lit and the threshold clean.'

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Abamath
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Silvenar
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Abamath (grid -5000, 10500 in Malabal Tor): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the Court of the Silvenar at Silvenar.

notes.title: Scout's Night-Watch Report: Abamath
notes.author: Outrider of the Court of the Silvenar
pages: Submitted to the guard-captain at Silvenar: at midnight we observed lantern-signals flashing from the upper masonry of Abamath (-5000, 10500 in Malabal Tor). Fresh tracks lead from the threshold toward the main road.
